subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should async sessions_send A2A responses omit delivery metadata, or should OpenClaw expose explicit sent/accepted/delivered status values for the same issue?
rationale: Two open closing PRs propose incompatible user-visible response metadata, and automation cannot safely choose the product contract for existing callers.

options.title: Adopt omitted async delivery
options.body: Use this PR's optional-field contract after the contributor posts real OpenClaw sessions_send proof for async and skipped paths.

options.title: Use explicit statuses instead
options.body: Prefer the sibling PR's sent/delivered/accepted status contract if maintainers want callers to continue receiving delivery metadata.

options.title: Design a queryable delivery contract
options.body: Pause both PRs and define a delivery id or status-query path if neither response-only contract is adequate.

recommendation.title: Adopt omitted async delivery
recommendation.body: Use this PR's optional-field contract after the contributor posts real OpenClaw sessions_send proof for async and skipped paths.
